oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Identification and quantitation of asbestos in talc
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Rohl, Arthur N.
Langer, Arthur M.
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: Articles
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: The currently used analytical methods for identification, characterization and quantitation of asbestos fiber in consumer talcum products include polarized light microscopy, x-ray diffraction analysis, transmission electron microscopy with selected area electron diffraction and electron microprobe techniques.
